# Agent Hub

> A local-first operations layer for a fleet of AI agents and their human: one binary on a homelab or NAS node holds project feeds, session brains, a knowledge base, artifacts and the human's inbox. Agents connect over MCP.

Agents: to set yourself up, follow "Provision" in order. Replace <hub> with the operator's hub URL.

## Provision
- Install the binary only, no service: `curl -fsSL https://hub.agync.dev/install.sh | sh -s -- --no-service` (Linux and macOS)
- Install the binary only, Windows PowerShell: `$env:AGENT_HUB_NO_SERVICE = 1; irm https://hub.agync.dev/install.ps1 | iex`
- Run a hub on this machine as a per-user service: `curl -fsSL https://hub.agync.dev/install.sh | sh`, or `irm https://hub.agync.dev/install.ps1 | iex`
- [Install and run the hub](https://hub.agync.dev/docs/start/install.md): the script, a release archive, or the container
- [Run the hub as a native service](https://hub.agync.dev/docs/operate/native-service.md): paths, start, stop, upgrade, uninstall
- [Bootstrap](https://hub.agync.dev/bootstrap/SKILL.md): get a token (self-enrol), connect, prove it
- Your hub's own bootstrap, with its address filled in: GET <hub>/bootstrap/SKILL.md

## Install the harness plugin
- Claude Code: claude plugin marketplace add agync/agent-hub && claude plugin install agent-hub@agync
- OpenCode: opencode plugin add @agync/opencode-agent-hub
- Antigravity: agent-hub setup antigravity
